config_jgate.fixed: 2026-11-15 14:40, before any J-gate result was computed. The detector outputs for the three reference queries were inspected first (DESIGN §5); the rule below reuses existing settings and was not adjusted to them.
config_jgate.naming_note: plan v3 §8 defines J-gate as 'verify the J-vlm choice with the Python rule, abstain on disagreement' (= J-gate-agree here). The existence check Claude described on 2026-11-15 is a different gate (= J-gate-exist). Both are computed and named separately.

existence_sources.L: predefined site object list (config site_vocabulary, written by a human before the experiment). Existence only, no position.
existence_sources.M: prior map of fixed objects. In this dev it is built from the answer-key boxes of fixed objects (same as J-geo's map); a system claim needs a map made from the separate M00 capture.
existence_sources.D: detector only: Grounding DINO run02 C2 output for the EXP110 English query whose text equals the parsed reference, boxes with score >= detector_threshold.
existence_sources.G: per-image answer key (oracle diagnostic). Never a system result.

config_jgate.detector_threshold_note: EXP110 registered C2 threshold (DESIGN §12.1); not tuned here
config_jgate.detector_query_rule: EXP110 English query with exactly the parsed reference text; no query -> treated as not confirmed (absent)
config_jgate.agree_note: L has no positions, so J-gate-agree cannot use it.
config_jgate.exist_rule: relation in gate_applies_to_relations and the reference is absent in the source -> abstain (reason reference_absent); otherwise the J-vlm answer passes unchanged
config_jgate.agree_rule: J-vlm abstains -> abstain; J-vlm picks id k -> keep k only if J-geo with the source's reference positions also picks k, else abstain (reason disagree)

referents_status: DRAFT by Claude 2026-11-15 from the answer-key positions and human-style judgement, NOT from the Python relation rule. Needs user review (referents_check_P0*.jpg). Boxes = EXP110 answer-key small_pallet boxes, raw distorted px.
